2607.13646.title: Human4K: A Large-Scale 4K Multi-View Mocap Dataset for Whole-Body 3D Human Reconstruction
2607.13646.paper_summary: Recent advances in 3D human reconstruction have improved overall performance, yet current models still fail in the most challenging real-world scenarios. They often produce unstable geometry, inaccurate limb articulation and unreliable predictions under depth ambiguity or self-occlusion. A key reason is that existing datasets still lack the combination of high-resolution images, high-precision annotations and diverse whole-body motions required to support robust reconstruction. To address this gap, we present Human4K, a large-scale 4K multi-view whole-body human reconstruction dataset with mocap-accurate SMPL-X annotations. Human4K contains over six million 4K images captured by an eight-view high-resolution camera system synchronized with a professional Vicon motion capture setup, covering 11 subjects performing complex, highly articulated and strongly self-occluded full-body motions. All sequences are processed by a Motion-Retargeting and Refinement Module (MRRM) to ensure precise alignment for the full body and extremities. Experimental results show that training with Human4K consistently improves whole-body reconstruction on standard benchmarks, with particularly large gains for hands, feet and depth-ambiguous limb configurations.
2607.13646.paper_summary_zh: 最近在3D人體重建方面的進展提高了整體性能，但目前的模型在最具挑戰性的現實場景中仍然無法達到預期效果。<lb/>它們經常產生不穩定的幾何形狀、不準確的肢體關節運動，以及在深度模糊或自遮擋情況下的不可靠預測。<lb/>一個主要原因是現有數據集仍然缺乏支持穩健重建所需的高解析度圖像、高精度標註和多樣化的全身動作的組合。<lb/>為了解決這一問題，我們推出了Human4K，一個大型4K多視角全身人體重建數據集，並附有動作捕捉精確的SMPL-X標註。<lb/>Human4K包含超過六百萬張由八視角高解析度攝影系統捕捉的4K圖像，這些攝影系統與專業的Vicon動作捕捉設置同步，涵蓋11名受試者執行複雜、高度關節化和強烈自遮擋的全身動作。<lb/>所有序列都經過運動重定向和精煉模塊（MRRM）處理，以確保全身及四肢的精確對齊。<lb/>實驗結果顯示，使用Human4K進行訓練在標準基準測試中持續改善全身重建，特別是在手、腳和深度模糊肢體配置方面獲得了顯著的提升。
